definitions.asymmetry: (u - d) / (u + d), u = log(high/P0), d = log(P0/low)
definitions.blocks: EARLY is 2020-2022 and LATE is 2023-2024, the split already visible in the published year table. Not a new threshold.
definitions.equal_width_line: EXPLORATORY_POST_OUTCOME linear description. Intercept is the fitted paired resolution difference at log width ratio 0. Not a control and not a claim.
definitions.excursion_marks: Shares at 0.5W, 1.0W and 1.5W are shape descriptions, not candidate tests.
definitions.partner_lag: Calendar days from the object day to the weekday half-rotation partner that supplied u and d. The frozen match is not changed.
definitions.post_decision_rv: sqrt of summed squared 5m log returns from the decision close across the next 48 returns (4h)
definitions.post_touch_rv: sqrt of summed squared 5m log returns from the touch-bar close across the next 48 returns
definitions.pre_formation_rv: sqrt of summed squared 5m log returns across the 12 closes immediately before formation (11 returns)
definitions.relative_width: W / P0, P0 = close of the last formation bar, the same close the pseudo bounds are placed on
definitions.wald_interval: Paired mean plus or minus 1.96 sample standard errors. Descriptive. Not a family test and not a pass/fail.
definitions.width_bins: PSEUDO_WIDER if W_real/W_pseudo < 0.8; SIMILAR if 0.8 to 1.25 inclusive; else REAL_WIDER. Round reciprocal cuts, not a searched match.
